# Whistral 0.3.2

## What's new

### Fluid Bottom-Edge Activation Glow

- **Visual Activation Cue:** When dictation begins, a luminous fluid glow ripples across the bottom edge of the screen, letting you immediately know voice detection is listening.
- **System Accent Color:** Matches the exact accent color selected in macOS System Settings.
- **Water-like Wave Animation:** Gentle sinusoidal ripples that wave organically and softly dissolve after 3 seconds.
- **Zero Click Interception:** The glow panel ignores mouse events entirely (`ignoresMouseEvents = true`), so clicking on the Dock, windows, or apps is never obstructed.

## Download & Install

### Via Homebrew Cask
```bash
brew tap ThriveEngineer/whistral https://github.com/ThriveEngineer/Whistral
brew install --cask whistral
```

### Direct Download
**[Whistral-0.3.2.zip](https://github.com/ThriveEngineer/Whistral/releases/download/v0.3.2/Whistral-0.3.2.zip)** (Notarized by Apple)

Unzip, drag `Whistral.app` to `/Applications`, and grant Accessibility + Microphone permissions when prompted.
